2607.07178.title: Entropy Pacing Policy Optimization for Multi-Task Agentic Reinforcement Learning
2607.07178.paper_summary: Recent breakthroughs of Reinforcement Learning (RL) have highlighted its potential for complex agentic Large Language Model (LLM) tasks. However, existing efforts largely focus on single-task settings, whereas real-world deployment necessitates a generalist agent capable of solving multiple tasks simultaneously. In this work, we identify a critical yet underexplored phenomenon in multi-task agentic RL: different tasks can exhibit exploration-exploitation pace mismatch. Specifically, easier tasks may converge early to low-entropy policies that hinder learning on harder tasks, while harder tasks can, in turn, push easier tasks back toward high-entropy exploration. This back-and-forth interaction creates inter-task entropy crossovers and frequent entropy spikes. Inspired by this observation, we introduce Entropy Pacing Policy Optimization (EPPO) for multi-task agentic LLMs, which coordinates entropy across tasks to stabilize multi-task optimization. At the core of EPPO is a task-wise dynamic clipping mechanism that replaces the fixed clipping threshold in Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with a task entropy-aware adaptive bound, tightening updates for over-confident tasks while relaxing them for under-explored ones. Experiments on the multi-task agentic benchmarks demonstrate that the proposed EPPO yields results superior to its counterparts.
2607.07178.paper_summary_zh: 最近強化學習（RL）的突破突顯了其在複雜代理大型語言模型（LLM）任務中的潛力。<lb/>然而，現有的努力主要集中在單一任務設定上，而現實世界的部署需要一個能夠同時解決多個任務的通才代理。<lb/>在本研究中，我們識別了一個關鍵但尚未充分探索的現象：在多任務代理RL中，不同任務可能會出現探索與利用的速度不匹配。<lb/>具體而言，較簡單的任務可能會早期收斂到低熵策略，這會阻礙更難任務的學習，而更難的任務則可能會將較簡單的任務推回高熵探索。<lb/>這種來回互動產生了任務間的熵交叉和頻繁的熵峰值。<lb/>受到這一觀察的啟發，我們為多任務代理LLMs引入了熵節奏政策優化（EPPO），該方法協調任務間的熵以穩定多任務優化。<lb/>EPPO的核心是一個基於任務的動態裁剪機制，該機制用一個基於任務熵的自適應界限取代了群體相對政策優化（GRPO）中的固定裁剪閾值，對過於自信的任務收緊更新，而對未充分探索的任務放鬆更新。<lb/>在多任務代理基準上的實驗表明，所提出的EPPO產生的結果優於其對手。
